title: TurkishMMLU: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding in Turkish
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of the 'Religion and Ethics' subject from the Turkish high school curriculum.
findings: Models generally performed well on questions from the 'Religion and Ethics' subject. This subject was part of the 'Social Sciences and Humanities' category, which was found to be the easiest subject group for most models. Top-performing closed-source models like GPT-4o and Claude-3 Opus achieved scores over 90% on Religion & Ethics questions.
